label: Feed Entry
description: An entry from an Atom or RSS 2.0 feed, as the RSS connector reads it: a bookmark whose title and description are plain text and whose body keeps the feed's markup, with the entry's id in its feed and the feed's address beside the bookmark's fields.

entry_id.description: The entry's id in its feed: its Atom id or RSS guid, else its link.

feed_url.description: The feed's address, as the connector was given it, without credentials or query, where a private feed carries its token.
